Markets.title: JGB yields edge higher amid fiscal, inflation worries
Markets.summary: Japanese government bond yields rose on Monday due to Middle East instability, inflation anxieties, and fiscal concerns. Additionally, Japan's ministries requested a record budget exceeding 130 trillion yen, further contributing to the yield increases.

Markets.title: Nifty loses 7% in 2026, smallcaps gain 13%; Is it time to bet on broader markets?
Markets.summary: The Nifty Smallcap 100 has surged nearly thirteen percent this year while the Nifty 50 index has declined seven percent. Driven by strong liquidity and mutual fund investments, analysts recommend that investors consider increasing their stakes in smallcap stocks.

Markets.title: Global Market:  Japan’s Nikkei swings as AI stocks slip ahead of Nvidia results
Markets.summary: Japan's Nikkei index fluctuated on Monday as investors grew cautious ahead of Nvidia's upcoming earnings report. Rising bond yields, inflation concerns, and potential Bank of Japan rate hikes also pressured AI-related stocks.

Markets.title: Will Paras Defence, MTAR Tech, HAL, other defence stocks deliver explosive returns? Here's what analysts say
Markets.summary: Defence stocks are rising due to government reforms and domestic procurement policies favoring companies like Paras Defence, MTAR Tech, and HAL. Although valuations are high, analysts recommend using market corrections as buying opportunities for future growth.

Markets.title: Apollo Tyres shares jump over 6% after UBS upgrades stock to Buy from Neutral. Here’s why
Markets.summary: UBS upgraded Apollo Tyres from Neutral to Buy and raised its target price to Rs 590. The brokerage cited earnings recovery potential driven by improving prospects in India and Europe despite near-term rubber cost pressures.

Markets.title: Global Market: KOSPI drops over 1% as Samsung Electronics slumps on payout concerns
Markets.summary: South Korea's KOSPI index dropped 1.31% on Monday due to a sharp decline in Samsung Electronics shares following disappointing shareholder return plans. Gains in other major companies like SK Hynix, LG Energy Solution, and POSCO Holdings partially offset the market losses.

Geo-Political.title: Burnham to hand long-range missile blueprints to Zelensky as he visits Kyiv
Geo-Political.summary: British official Burnham is visiting Kyiv to give Ukraine blueprints for long-range missiles. This visit follows Moscow's warnings of consequences regarding Ukraine's reported use of British drones.

Geo-Political.title: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC gained rare access to senior Taliban figures to observe how the group is reshaping Afghanistan five years after retaking power. The reporting highlights the Taliban's strict control over society, including impacts on personal relationships like divorce and the use of smartphones.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
Geo-Political.summary: Following the collapse of trade talks and Canada's announcement of retaliatory tariffs, Donald Trump claimed that Canada wants the benefits of becoming a U.S. state. Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau accused the United States of starting a trade war.

Geo-Political.title: Shein aims for almost $27bn valuation in stock market debut
Geo-Political.summary: Fast-fashion giant Shein is targeting a valuation of nearly $27 billion for its upcoming stock market debut. The company's shares are scheduled to begin trading in Hong Kong on September 1.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
Geo-Political.summary: Former cricket captains are urging Pakistan to provide proper medical care for jailed ex-prime minister Imran Khan. They stated that complying with a court-ordered medical assessment is a matter of basic decency.

Geo-Political.title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 30
Geo-Political.summary: A massive mound of rubbish collapsed at a major waste site in Guinea's capital, burying several homes. The disaster resulted in the deaths of at least 30 people.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic compared to traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize digital content creation in 2025. These applications help modern creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: AI, semicon, global value chains: How globalization isn't dying—it's evolving
Data & Insights.summary: Global trade is shifting from physical goods to services and strategic technologies like semiconductors and AI. Rather than dying, global supply chains and capital are simply reconfiguring and transforming.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Hawkish RBI minutes, drought warning, rural workforce
Data & Insights.summary: Mint's weekly data compilation features charts analyzing the Reserve Bank of India's hawkish minutes, growing drought warnings, and trends in the rural workforce. These insights provide a deeper look into the key stories reported throughout the past week.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments under eased norms for land-border countries as of 20 August. These investments span sectors like IT, AI, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, though their exact origins from China remain unclear.

Data & Insights.title: India economic growth may beat RBI forecast: Deputy governor says 7% pace possible as indicators improve
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could reach nearly 7%, surpassing the central bank's previous 6.7% forecast due to stronger-than-expected indicators. Meanwhile, financial markets are increasing their bets that the central bank will raise interest rates later this year.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector growth likely picked up in August: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector growth likely accelerated in August, according to the HSBC Flash India PMI survey. This advance estimate provides an early signal of positive shifts in the country's economic output and sentiment.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Consumers are increasingly buying premium high-octane petrol due to concerns that ethanol-blended E20 fuel could damage engines and reduce mileage. This shift has driven the sales share of premium petrol up to 12-15% from approximately 4% in March.

India.title: Tamil Nadu Drops Parandur Airport Project, Vijay Says "I Stand With Protesters"
India.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay announced that the proposed Parandur airport project has been dropped. He stated that he stands firm with the protesters who opposed the airport.

India.title: For Gen Z Outreach, Rahul Gandhi's Wardrobe Gets A Peppy Makeover
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi has updated his wardrobe with colored shirts to appeal to Gen Z voters. He is wearing these peppy outfits while hosting the "Chhatron Ki Gunj" program to address paper leak issues.

India.title: Woman Dies By Suicide In Bengaluru After Complaining Of Blackmail, Harassment
India.summary: A woman in Bengaluru died by suicide after allegedly facing blackmail and harassment. Police stated that she left a note naming a person named Abhishek as the responsible party.

India.title: Haryana's POCSO Awareness Drive Reaches 3.1 Lakh Students Across 1,731 Schools
India.summary: Between May and August, the Haryana Legal Services Authority launched an awareness campaign in schools regarding the POCSO Act and child safety. The initiative successfully reached 3.1 lakh students across 1,731 schools in the state.

India.title: US Visa Rule Changes: Harvard Asks International Students To Return Before September 15
India.summary: Harvard University has advised its international students to return to the United States before September 15. This warning comes in response to new visa regulations that could impact the admission status of F-1 and J-1 visa holders.

India.title: 3 Newborns Die After Ventilator Blast Triggers Fire At Maharashtra Hospital
India.summary: A ventilator blast triggered a fire at a hospital in Maharashtra, resulting in the deaths of three newborns. Hospital staff evacuated the remaining infants and disconnected medical equipment to move babies away from the affected area.

General.title: Burnham to hand long-range missile blueprints to Zelensky as he visits Kyiv
General.summary: British official Andy Burnham is visiting Kyiv to give Ukraine the blueprints for long-range missiles. This visit follows Moscow's warnings of consequences after Ukraine reportedly used British drones.

General.title: Families of two police officers killed in crash say they were heroes
General.summary: PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough were killed in a car crash alongside five occupants of the other vehicle. The families of the two police officers have publicly stated that they were heroes.

General.title: How easy is it to find an NHS dentist? It depends where you live
General.summary: Nearly 600 dental practices in England have left the NHS over the past decade. This decline has created a two-tier system where finding an NHS dentist depends heavily on where a patient lives.

General.title: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
General.summary: Tesla is recalling nearly three million vehicles in China due to a safety issue involving hidden door handles. Several other automakers, including XPeng, Xiaomi, and Geely, are also affected by the recall.

General.summary: Labour called the plan "unserious and unworkable" and accused Reform of pushing "gimmicks and division".
